## berth env unset

remove a variable (restarts a running org)

### Synopsis

remove a variable (restarts a running org)

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_env_unset/

```
berth env unset <org> KEY [--no-restart] [flags]
```

### Examples

```

```
